title: Internal: Lost/Stolen Card - Cross-Product Security Protocol
summary: This document instructs agents on the cross-product security protocol when a customer reports a lost/stolen Rho-Bank debit card: complete the standard debit card freeze/close, check credit cards on file, and proactively offer a replacement credit card with a new card number if the customer also had a credit card in the stolen wallet. It specifies using get_credit_card_accounts_by_user and, if the customer declines, noting the offer in the account.
faqs: What steps must I take when a customer reports a lost or stolen Rho-Bank debit card?
After freezing the debit card, how do I check whether the customer has Rho-Bank credit cards on file?
If the customer has a Rho-Bank credit card, should I offer protection, and what exactly should I offer?
How do I proceed if the customer says their credit card was in the lost/stolen wallet?
If the customer declines the replacement credit card, what should I record?
What script wording does the document provide for offering a replacement credit card?
keywords: note in the account offer was made
